mapper.select: SELECT category AS category, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM TRANSACTIONS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'EXPENSE' AND transaction_date BETWEEN #{condition.startDate} AND #{condition.endDate} GROUP BY category ORDER BY amount DESC, category ASC

SELECT transaction_date AS date, type AS type, category AS category, amount AS amount, merchant_name AS merchantName FROM TRANSACTIONS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND transaction_date BETWEEN #{condition.startDate} AND #{condition.endDate} AND category <> 'CARD_WITHDRAWAL' ORDER BY transaction_date DESC, transaction_time DESC, transaction_id DESC LIMIT #{condition.size} OFFSET #{condition.offset}
